resources.title: Financial Sample Workbook
resources.description: Microsoft's own Financial Sample Excel workbook — the exact sample data two early lessons connect to and build your first visuals from. Already downloadable from those two lessons; it's listed here too so the Resource Vault surfaces every real course file in one place, not just the new reference material below.

resources.title: DAX Quick Reference
resources.description: A one-page syntax reference covering every DAX function this course actually teaches — CALCULATE, the SUMX/RANKX iterator family, filter modifiers (REMOVEFILTERS, KEEPFILTERS, USERELATIONSHIP), ALL/ALLEXCEPT/ALLSELECTED, the full time-intelligence set (DATEADD, TOTALYTD, DATESYTD, DATESBETWEEN), and VAR/RETURN — each with the course's own worked example, organized by how you'll actually reach for them rather than alphabetically.

resources.title: Data Model Documentation Template
resources.description: A fill-in template for writing down what a model actually is before you forget why you built it that way: a table inventory (fact vs. dimension, grain), a relationship log (cardinality, cross filter direction, active/inactive, and WHY each choice was made), and a hierarchy list. Comes filled in with a real worked example built on AdventureWorksDW2014's star schema, including its role-playing DimDate relationships.

resources.title: Power Query Transformation Steps Reference
resources.description: An ordered checklist of the Power Query cleanup operations this course teaches — data types, row filtering, replacing values and handling cell-level vs. step-level errors, splitting/merging/extracting columns, conditional columns, Group By aggregations, merging and appending queries, and parameters — sequenced the way a real cleanup pass actually needs them, not alphabetically.
